description: The spray keeps a share of the craft's velocity (issue #75): at full speed on Gull Cove the rooster tail and the bow spray trail back from where they are thrown, rather than being left where they were thrown in a string of puffs. Spray gives each emitter the craft's velocity after the emitters' own processing, which hands the renderer a zero velocity; without it the rooster tail's particles reached 11.2 m behind the nozzle and the bow spray's 8.2 m, with it 6.2 and 6.7 m (RenderingServer.particles_get_current_aabb, along the craft).

steps.name: the spray sets the emitters' velocity after their own processing
the rooster tail reaches less than 8.5 m behind the nozzle
the bow spray reaches less than 7.5 m back
